claims.quote: The principle is that no man's work ought to be, on the whole, harder for him than any other man's for him, the workers themselves to be the judges.
claims.description: A state labor administration equalizes the attractiveness of occupations, adjusting working hours to arduousness based on rates of volunteering.

claims.quote: The lighter trades, prosecuted under the most agreeable circumstances, have in this way the longest hours, while an arduous trade, such as mining, has very short hours.
claims.description: Working hours vary inversely with how arduous a trade is, so that harder jobs have shorter hours.

claims.quote: It is the grade to which all new recruits belong for the first three years of their service.
claims.description: Every citizen serves three years as an unskilled common laborer under discipline in a universal industrial conscription before choosing a trade.

claims.quote: Dependence on the purely voluntary choice of avocations involves the abolition in all of anything like unhygienic conditions or special peril to life and limb.
claims.description: Because occupations are freely chosen, dangerous and unhealthy working conditions are eliminated in all industries.

claims.quote: the administration, while depending on the voluntary system for filling up the trades as a rule, holds always in reserve the power to call for special volunteers, or draft any force needed from any quarter.
claims.description: The state labor administration can call for special volunteers or conscript labor wherever needed.

claims.quote: The schools of technology, of medicine, of art, of music, of histrionics, and of higher liberal learning are always open to aspirants without condition.
claims.description: Professional and higher education is run by the nation and open to all aspirants, with graduation proving ability.

claims.quote: Since the nation is the sole employer, the government must fix the rate of wages and determine just how much everybody shall earn, from the doctors to the diggers.
claims.description: The nation becomes the sole employer of all workers, with the government setting wages.

claims.quote: There is neither selling nor buying nowadays; the distribution of goods is effected in another way. As to the bankers, having no money we have no use for those gentry.
claims.description: Money, buying and selling, merchants and banks are abolished; goods are distributed without trade.

claims.quote: as soon as the nation became the sole producer of all sorts of commodities, there was no need of exchanges between individuals that they might get what they required.
claims.description: The nation becomes the sole producer of all commodities, replacing private production.

claims.quote: A credit corresponding to his share of the annual product of the nation is given to every citizen on the public books at the beginning of each year, and a credit card issued him with which he procures at the public storehouses, found in every community, whatever he desires whenever he desires it.
claims.description: Each citizen receives an annual equal credit and a credit card to obtain goods from public storehouses, replacing money.

claims.quote: our credit would not be transferable, being strictly personal.
claims.description: Credit cards are non-transferable, so individuals cannot sell or trade purchasing power.

claims.quote: buying and selling is considered absolutely inconsistent with the mutual benevolence and disinterestedness which should prevail between citizens and the sense of community of interest which supports our social system.
claims.description: A cultural shift in which commerce between individuals is regarded as anti-social and replaced by gift-giving.

claims.quote: the nation guarantees the nurture, education, and comfortable maintenance of every citizen from the cradle to the grave.
claims.description: The state guarantees every citizen's upbringing, education, and comfortable support throughout life.

claims.quote: The nation is rich, and does not wish the people to deprive themselves of any good thing.
claims.description: Saving is discouraged and ceases to be a virtue because the state's provision removes any need for it.

claims.quote: I know, as well as I know that the world now is heaven compared with what it was in your day, that the only feeling you will have after a little while will be one of thankfulness
claims.description: The society of the year 2000 is portrayed as vastly better than the nineteenth century.

claims.quote: opening the front door, which was fastened with a slightness indicating that burglary was not among the perils of the modern Boston
claims.description: Crime such as burglary has disappeared in the future city.

claims.quote: The nation does not maim and slaughter its workmen by thousands, as did the private capitalists and corporations of your day.
claims.description: Industrial accidents and worker deaths are eliminated under national production.
